_doc: What each debuff does to the hero's actions and his quiz (Brandon, 2026-11-22: the monster-effects audit, 'All as recommended'). src/action_gate.py reads 'gate', src/status_effects.py reads 'statuses', src/quiz_sight.py reads 'quiz', src/game_effects.py says the 'lines'. Every action of the hero's is one of the 'doors', and the gate is asked where that action is committed, never only at the key that opened its menu.

doors.ride: get into or out of the saddle
doors.strike: a melee blow, bumped or aimed with A
doors.shoot: a bow, crossbow or sling shot
doors.throw: throw a thing from the pack
doors.swap: take a thing into the hand or onto the body
doors.drink: drink from the pack or a fountain
doors.read: read a scroll or a book
doors.apply: a coating, the earplugs, a lantern's oil
doors.work: harvest, cook, identify, pick a lock, dig, search, parley

gate._doc: lose: the try spends the turn. refuse: nothing happens and no turn passes. aimed: refused at the creature that laid the effect. first_drop, first_fall, first_fizzle: once a bout, and never in Guard or for a self-inflicted bout. Doors not named are open.

statuses._doc: refresh: a second dose runs to the longer of the two, never their sum. caps: the most one dose can last (a price the game announces may pass its own cap). steps: the turns an action spends of the status (Slowed counts the world's turns, and each slowed action gives the world two).

petrify._doc: The countdown: above slow_at stiff, at slow_at or less slow (every action takes two turns), at rigid_at or less a line each turn. A lethal bout ends in stone; any other in a short paralysis.

knockdown._doc: A shove that beat the hero's STR save also floors him; a landed trample asks a DEX save when no other effect of that blow took hold. A gore, a tusk or an antler is a thrust, not a trample: its attack says "floors": false (it stays a trample for the boots' guard). A standing hero has his footing for statuses.footing_turns.

poison._doc: Poison on the hero (src/venom.py; Brandon 2026-11-22: 'two damage? why have these cure poison potions'). A monster's bite does its attack's own 'venom' a turn (data/monsters.json, written by lore in tools/content/poison_pass_2026_11_22.py, never by floor); a poison with none (a potion, a trap, foul water) keeps status_effects.DOT_SHARE of max HP. A bite on a poisoned hero adds add_share of its turns, never past most_doses of the longest dose; the strongest venom on him sets the tick. A CON save (d20 + CON mod + save bonus against the attack's dc) halves the dose and never cancels it. Venom Ward (status venom_ward) halves both the venom and the turns. What it will still take is drawn on the HP bar and said on the chip and the bite's line: venom.to_come.

lines.bitten: {by}'s venom is in you: {n} to come.
lines.food: Your stomach churns: food poisoning, {n} to come.
lines.saved: Your body throws off half the venom: {n} to come.
lines.deadly: The venom will kill you unless it is cured.

quiz._doc: Display only. Confused, Stunned and Hallucinating share ONE settle time (confusion's: they run side by side and never add up), so no pile of effects is an auto-kill. Blinded has no wait: the question stays lit and the arrows move a pool of light over the answers; the number keys answer as ever. A false answer keeps a slot of its own, so no real answer changes its number when it fades. Reaching for it is no answer. Nothing flashes or shakes.

phantom._doc: A false answer is only ever one that can be shown false. A sum with one value (closed_stems) borrows another sum's wrong number; a which-divides sum one that does not divide. Any other question, whose borrowed answer might well be true, gets dream words that mean nothing (dream).
closed_stems: ^(Solve|Round|Double|Half of|Count by|Pyth\. triple|Cube root of|What % of|Decrease|Increase|From)\b
^[^A-Za-z]+ ?(squared|cubed|simplified|as a percent|as a decimal|as percent|as decimal)\b

chips.double: Stunned: two of everything, sliding together
chips.phantom: Hallucinating: one answer is not there

quiz.nothing_there: Your hand closes on nothing. It was never there.

lines.sleeping: You are fast asleep -- you cannot act.
lines.paralyzed: You are paralyzed -- you cannot act.
lines.stand: You climb back to your feet.
lines.frozen_feet: Ice locks your legs. You cannot move.
lines.frozen_hands: Your hands are numb with ice. You can still strike, cast or read.
lines.frozen_hint: A lit torch would thaw you.
lines.thaw: You hold the flame to the ice, and it runs off you as water.
lines.immobilized: Your feet are held fast. You can still strike, shoot and use your hands.
lines.silenced: You are silenced: you can neither cast nor read aloud.
lines.hexed: The hex holds it to you. What you wear will not come off.
lines.feared_step: You cannot make yourself go nearer {the}. You can step away, shoot, cast or drink.
lines.feared_strike: You cannot make yourself strike {the}. You can step away, shoot, cast or drink.
lines.charmed_strike: You cannot lift a hand against {the}. You can fight anything else.
lines.charm_broken: The wound breaks {the}'s charm. Your hands are your own again.
lines.bout_source_gone: With {the} gone, its hold on you is gone too.
lines.fall: You step, the floor tips, and you fall. Getting up takes a turn. (Stand still, fight or be in Guard while Stunned.)
lines.drop: Your hands will not obey: the {item} falls at your feet. (In Guard you would have held it.)
lines.drop_plain: Your hands will not obey, and you lose the moment. (In Guard you would have managed it.)
lines.fizzle: The words slide away from you and the spell fizzles. No MP is spent.
lines.floored: You are knocked off your feet!
lines.stiff_slow: Your skin is hardening to stone: every action takes two turns.
lines.rigid_lethal: Your limbs are rigid -- death is moments away!
lines.stone_trap: You are turning to stone! Oil of Rue, Cleanse, a cure-all or a prayer for mercy (a chain of four) stops it.
lines.stone_saved: The stone closes over you, and cracks: what wards you from death has broken it.
lines.lesser_end: The stone closes over your joints, and for a moment you cannot move at all.
lines.forgot_item: {The} feeds on your mind. You no longer know what the {item} is! Kill {him} on this floor to win it back.
lines.forgot_page: {The} feeds on your mind. All you had learned of the {kind} is gone! Kill {him} on this floor to win it back.
lines.forgot_nothing: {The} gropes through your mind and finds nothing it can take.
lines.remembered: What it ate comes flooding back: {what}.
lines.lost_for_good: What was eaten from your mind stays behind. You will have to learn it again: {what}.
